batch: 3 (chs 12-19, false prophets, idols in the heart, the faithless bride, turn and live)

units.characteristics: eyes that see not; false prophets of their own spirit; peace where there is no peace
units.gist: the rebellious house 'who have EYES TO SEE but SEE NOT, ears to hear but hear not'; the exile-baggage sign; the false prophets 'who prophesy from their OWN HEARTS, who follow their OWN SPIRIT and HAVE SEEN NOTHING', smearing the flimsy wall with WHITEWASH, crying 'PEACE when there is no peace'; and 'disheartening the RIGHTEOUS falsely and ENCOURAGING THE WICKED that he should not turn' - self-sourced false comfort inverting good and evil

units.characteristics: idols set up in the heart; each saves only himself by his own righteousness
units.gist: GEM - 'these men have taken THEIR IDOLS INTO THEIR HEARTS, and set the stumbling block of their iniquity before their faces' (the idol enthroned inwardly, before any outward image); 'REPENT and turn away from your idols'; and though 'NOAH, DANIEL, and JOB' were in the land, 'they would deliver but THEIR OWN LIVES by their righteousness' (righteousness non-transferable); the useless vine fit only for fire

units.characteristics: the foundling love; trust in one's beauty/gifts; the never-satisfied whoring; the shame that mercy produces
units.gist: GEM - the abandoned newborn 'wallowing in your blood', to whom God said 'LIVE!', washed, adorned, 'perfect through the splendour I bestowed'; 'but you TRUSTED IN YOUR BEAUTY and played the whore... you were NOT SATISFIED' (the gift turned against the Giver, insatiable); Sodom's guilt 'PRIDE, excess of food, prosperous EASE, but did not aid the poor'; 'HOW SICK IS YOUR HEART'; yet 'I will REMEMBER my covenant... establish an EVERLASTING covenant... that you may remember and be ASHAMED... when I ATONE for you'

units.characteristics: the sanctity of a sworn oath; faithlessness to a covenant
units.gist: the two-eagles riddle - Zedekiah 'made a covenant... put under OATH' but 'REBELLED... will he thrive? can he break the covenant and escape?'; 'he DESPISED THE OATH in breaking the covenant... surely it is MY OATH that he despised, and MY COVENANT that he broke; I will return it upon his head' - a sworn word treated as God's own; faithlessness to an oath as a sin against God

units.characteristics: individual moral responsibility; God's no-pleasure in death; make a new heart, turn and live
units.gist: THE GEM - 'the SOUL WHO SINS SHALL DIE... the son shall NOT suffer for the iniquity of the father... the righteousness of the righteous shall be UPON HIMSELF'; the wicked who turns 'shall surely LIVE; NONE of his transgressions shall be remembered'; 'HAVE I ANY PLEASURE IN THE DEATH OF THE WICKED... and not rather that he should TURN and LIVE?'; 'make yourselves a NEW HEART and a new spirit! Why will you die? for I have NO PLEASURE in the death of anyone; so TURN, and LIVE'

units.characteristics: the lament over the fallen; grief woven into judgment
units.gist: a LAMENT (qinah) for the princes of Israel - the lioness and her cubs caged and led away, the vine once fruitful now plucked up, planted in the wilderness, consumed by fire; 'this is a lamentation and has become a lamentation' - judgment carried as a dirge, the fallen mourned even as they fall (thin inner-being; the grieving mode)
